question: Do the authors also analyze transformer-based architectures?
title: Neural Network Models for Paraphrase Identification, Semantic Textual Similarity, Natural Language Inference, and Question Answering
answer_rationale: The document analyzes several neural network architectures including LSTM-based models, Tree-LSTM, and attention-based models like Decomposable Attention and Enhanced Sequential Inference Model, but it does not mention any transformer-based architectures.
